title: Flu COVID Vaccine Views
official: Factors Driving Willingness to Receive Influenza, COVID-19, and Combination Influenza/COVID-19 Vaccines Among Health Care Workers
summary: This study addresses a critical evidence gap relevant to implementation strategies for combination vaccines in health care settings. This study will specifically investigate healthcare worker (HCWs) attitudes around and willingness to receive combination influenza/COVID-19 vaccines. Findings will identify determinants of hesitancy and acceptance among HCWs and support effective rollout strategies and communication approaches. Cross-sectional surveys and qualitative interviews will be conducted with healthcare workers to characterize HCW willingness to be vaccinated and to identify demographic, attitudinal, and structural predictors of vaccination.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18-89 years old
* Currently employed or enrolled as a student at GWU, GW MFA or CNH
* Eligible for institutional influenza vaccination
* Able to complete the survey in English

Exclusion Criteria:

* On long-term leave at the time of survey launch
* Contractors without institutional email access
* Contraindication to receiving influenza vaccination
* Contraindication to receiving COVID-19 vaccination
